english: Let $f:[0,14]\to\mathbb{R}$ be defined by $f(x)=\max\left\{[x],\,|x-7|\right\}$, where $[t]$ denotes the greatest integer less than or equal to $t$. Then the value of $\displaystyle\int_{0}^{14}f(x)\,dx$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $f:[0,14]\to\mathbb{R}$, $f(x)=\max\left\{[x],\,|x-7|\right\}$ द्वारा परिभाषित है, जहाँ $[t]$, $t$ से कम या उसके बराबर महत्तम पूर्णांक को दर्शाता है। तब $\displaystyle\int_{0}^{14}f(x)\,dx$ का मान ______ है।
solution_full: On each $[n,n+1)$, $n=0,1,\dots,13$, $[x]=n$, so $f(x)=\max\{n,|x-7|\}$ there; by additivity the integral is the sum over these $14$ subintervals.
originality_note: New: the maximum of a step function and a V-shaped function, where the V wins only on [0,4] and the steps win elsewhere; the student must locate the switch (way 2). Closest known: int max([x], {x}) dx and int |x - a| dx. Different because: the comparison changes along the interval and the V is centred inside.
blueprint_concepts: Additivity over subintervals for piecewise and discontinuous integrands
Definite integrals of GIF and fractional part functions
Definite integrals with modulus and max / min integrands

concept_use.Additivity over subintervals for piecewi: The integral is split at every integer of [0,14] (where [x] jumps) and the pieces are added.
concept_use.Definite integrals of GIF and fractional: [x] is constant n on [n, n+1), which makes each piece either n or a linear function.
concept_use.Definite integrals with modulus and max: max{n, |x-7|} must be resolved on each unit interval; the switch happens exactly at x = 4.

stem_review: Read as a student: f defined on [0,14]; [t] defined; checked numerically: 105. Answer is a positive 3-digit integer as planned. Changed: No change.
key_step: Find where |x - 7| exceeds [x] (only for x < 4), then integrate pieces.
justification: Careful casework over 14 unit intervals with one switch point; numerical answer with no check. Comparable to 2021-P2-Q19 (L4) in kind but with simpler breakpoints, so L3.
